# ODW Logistics

ODW Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. ODW Logistics provides integrated 3PL logistics services, including transportation management, warehousing and distribution, and e-commerce fulfillment. ODW Logistics employs 1,102 people (+10.9% YoY, +108 people) and has an annual revenue of $210M, founded in 1971. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, United States, with offices including Brookville, Romeoville, OH, McDonough, and Waukesha. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Denmark, and Ghana.

## About

ODW Logistics is a third-party logistics company (3PL) providing end-to-end supply chain solutions including warehouse & distribution, e-commerce fulfillment, transportation management, freight brokerage, and supply chain design.

ODW Logistics is a passionate group of team members who are committed to the growth of our company while living our core values at work, home and in our community.

Our growth is fueled by our extraordinary people delivering the difference to our customers everyday.
